sources.title: 1 Introduction - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: CIPHER is a large language model specifically trained and fine-tuned on a comprehensive penetration testing dataset. Leveraging advancements in generative AI, CIPHER aims to automate and enhance the penetration testing process, making it more efficient and accessible, especially for individuals with limited penetration testing knowledge.
